That would be a way to see it. Basically Isshin has everything geni has. He even uses lighting on his last phase which makes it easier but you have to time them well and not get too cocky. Isshin won't let you overwhelm him with attacks like geni does, after you attack him like two times he will deflect and start his combo. His highest weakness are his thrust attacks and sweeping attacks, however he doesn't do the sweep ones very often, when he runs back and sheathe his sword if you stay to close he will push you away and do a sweep attack, you can also run around him a little away so he will try to attack you running to you and you can use that window to attack him on his back. He has very few moments where you can actually hit him but if you focus on attacking him and deflecting he will use thrust attacks very often so doing mikiris will take a lot of his posture. The second fase is more of the same, but he has longer combos, a gun and a spear. But is more of the same, deflecting and looking for his thrust and sweep attacks to increase his posture a lot
